name: Weber-Fechner JND Law
axiom: A just-noticeable difference is a ratio of the starting magnitude, not a fixed amount.
trigger: Two controls differ by the same amount, but one change is obvious and the other is invisible.
checklist: Set type hierarchy by ratio, not equal steps: 16, 20, 25, 31 px reads as clear levels.
Check dark-theme borders with the same relative contrast step, not the same hex delta.
Scale spacing and progress changes as a fraction of the current value.

antiPattern.violation: Heading sizes step 16, 18, 20 px, so three levels look like one.
antiPattern.remediation: A 1.25 ratio gives 16, 20, 25 px, and each level reads as its own rank.

parametricParams.caption: EQUAL RATIOS MAKE EQUAL PERCEIVED STEPS

academicOrigin.title: De Pulsu, Resorptione, Auditu et Tactu: Annotationes Anatomicae et Physiologicae
